design.decision: Bid nil on borderline hands when the partner can still carry a contract, since the points need the contract made.
design.opponent: Revealed at the nil bid; opponents can attack either the nil or the partner's contract.
design.rationale: Rewards the bid rather than the outcome, but as contract points it still needs the partner's contract, so it rewards the whole team plan rather than only the nil.
design.draftText: +80 contract points when your team bids nil

critic.concerns: Pays even when the nil fails, as long as the partner makes the contract, so it may reward throwaway nils; the BidHigh tag is weak.

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-bidnil-pts); credited to both sources.
